objective: The first group has one line worth keeping and one line of junk -- clear both, pull the kept line back.
The second has two lines of junk before the spot -- the kept line falls one register deeper.
The third works better with a named register than the numbered stack.
The fourth and fifth are identical -- record a macro on the fourth and replay it on the fifth.
The sixth doesn't need a new line at all -- pull the kept value straight into the spot's own line.
The seventh buries the kept line under three rounds of junk -- deeper still on the numbered stack.
The eighth's junk and spot aren't right next to the kept line -- search for each one.
